record: Led a letter with 14 other House members asking the Commerce Department's Acting Inspector General to investigate possible conflicts of interest in the May 2025 approval of AI chip exports to the UAE (export controls and corruption, not catastrophic AI risk).

With Rep. Meeks, wrote to Commerce Secretary Lutnick questioning the upgrade of the UAE's export-control status and safeguards against AI chip diversion to China (export controls, not catastrophic AI risk).
grade_reason: Her AI-related activity in 2026 is letters on AI chip exports to the UAE, about export controls and conflicts of interest, which is level D. No statement acknowledging catastrophic risk from AI was found.
